#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

echo "$(date) Waiting for uniform_seed42 training to complete..."
while true; do
    if ! nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader --id=0 2>/dev/null | grep -q "[0-9]"; then
        echo "$(date) GPU 0 freed. Checking for checkpoint..."
        sleep 15
        break
    fi
    PROGRESS=$(tail -1 /root/runs/provenance_weight_training/qwen06b_uniform_seed42.log 2>/dev/null | grep -oP '\d+/8477' | head -1)
    echo "$(date) Still training... $PROGRESS"
    sleep 30
done

CKPT="/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/uniform_seed42/final"
if [ ! -d "$CKPT" ]; then
    CKPT=$(find /root/autodl-tmp -path "*uniform_seed42*final*" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1)
fi

if [ -z "$CKPT" ] || [ ! -d "$CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: uniform_seed42 checkpoint not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "$(date) Found checkpoint: $CKPT"
OUTDIR="/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/eval/uniform_fewshot"

# HellaSwag 10-shot
echo "$(date) Running HellaSwag 10-shot..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$CKPT,dtype=float16 \
  --tasks hellaswag --num_fewshot 10 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/hellaswag/ 2>&1

# ARC-Easy 25-shot
echo "$(date) Running ARC-Easy 25-shot..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$CKPT,dtype=float16 \
  --tasks arc_easy --num_fewshot 25 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/arc_easy/ 2>&1

# PIQA 5-shot
echo "$(date) Running PIQA 5-shot..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$CKPT,dtype=float16 \
  --tasks piqa --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/piqa/ 2>&1

# WinoGrande 5-shot
echo "$(date) Running WinoGrande 5-shot..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$CKPT,dtype=float16 \
  --tasks winogrande --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/winogrande/ 2>&1

echo "$(date) ALL UNIFORM EVALS DONE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/run_uniform_fewshot_eval.sh
nohup bash /tmp/run_uniform_fewshot_eval.sh > /tmp/uniform_fewshot_eval.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
